name: roll ball lower back
description: Rolling a small ball under your lower back to release tight spots and loosen the muscles beside the spine.
instructions: Lie on your back with a small ball under one side of your lower back.
Bend your knees and keep your feet flat on the floor.
Shift your weight slowly so the ball rolls along the muscle next to the spine.
Pause on tender spots for a few breaths, then move on.
Switch sides and keep the pressure comfortable, never on the spine itself.
